h1: The 4 Best Toro Leaf Blowers of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Toro Leaf Blowers: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: four Toro leaf blowers, from 60V cordless brushless models to a corded vacuum mulcher, with airflow figures and tradeoffs.
summary: The Toro 60V Max brushless with 605 CFM and 120 MPH is the best all-round Toro here. The Flex Force 565 CFM model is a close cordless alternative, the 115 MPH 605 CFM listing is the cheapest cordless option, and the Toro 51609 Ultra is the corded vacuum mulcher.
intro: Toro sells blowers across two very different jobs, and mixing them up is the typical mistake. A cordless 60V model is about clearing leaves fast without a cord, while the corded Ultra is also a vacuum and mulcher.
We reviewed four Toro blowers and ranked them on the listed specifications: airflow, battery platform, speed and function. Where a listing gives no figure, we leave it out.

products.name: Toro 60-Volt Max Electric Brushless Cordless Leaf Blower with 120 MPH
products.verdict: 605 CFM and 120 MPH from a brushless cordless 60V Max platform.
products.description:
This Toro runs on the 60V Max platform with a brushless motor, listing 605 CFM of airflow and 120 MPH. It is cordless, so there is no cable to drag.

It ranks first because it pairs top Toro airflow with a cordless design, which the corded Ultra cannot match. Against the Flex Force it adds about 40 CFM.

Choose it for typical yards. The caveat is the $100 to $200 tier.
products.idealFor: Typical yards that want cordless power.

products.name: Toro Flex Force 60-Volt Max Brushless and Cordless Leaf Blower
products.verdict: 565 CFM on the Flex Force 60V Max brushless platform.
products.description:
The Flex Force is a 60V Max brushless cordless blower listing 565 CFM.

It ranks second because the airflow is lower than the top pick by 40 CFM, though both share the same price tier of $100 to $200.

It suits buyers in the Flex Force ecosystem. The caveat is the lower airflow.

products.name: Toro 115 MPH 605 CFM 60-Volt Max Lithium-Ion Brushless Cordless Leaf Blower
products.verdict: 605 CFM and 115 MPH in the $50 to $100 tier.
products.description:
This listing offers 605 CFM and 115 MPH from a 60V Max lithium-ion brushless cordless design.

It ranks third because the speed is 5 MPH below the top pick, but it is the lowest-priced cordless Toro, in the $50 to $100 tier.

Buy it for the lowest cost. The caveat is slightly less speed.

products.name: Toro 51609 Ultra 12 amp Variable-Speed Electric Blower
products.verdict: A 12 amp variable-speed electric that also vacuums and mulches.
products.description:
The Ultra is a 12 amp variable-speed electric listed as a vacuum and mulcher, with speed up to 235.

It ranks fourth because it is a different tool, listing no CFM, and it costs more, in the $200 to $500 tier.

It suits buyers who want to vacuum and mulch leaves. The caveat is it is an electric model rather than cordless.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want to mulch leaves.

whatMatters.detail: CFM is the volume of air moved. It decides how fast you clear leaves. Check for the figure in the title.
MPH lifts stuck, wet leaves. Compare it with CFM. Look for it in the title.
Cordless frees you from a cable but depends on battery. Corded runs as long as it is plugged in. Check the power type.
A brushless motor is described as more efficient than a brushed one. Look for the word brushless in the listing.
A mulcher shreds leaves to reduce volume. It only matters if you bag leaves. Check for vacuum or mulcher in the title.

finalTake: The Toro 60-Volt Max Brushless with 120 MPH is the best Toro leaf blower here. The Flex Force is the choice if you already own that platform, and the 115 MPH model is the budget cordless option. The Ultra is the one for mulching.
